info.name: HustleHub+ API - Part 2
info.description:
Full Part 2 API test suite: authentication, RBAC, gigs, bookings, transactions, income, security checks and rate limiting.

Run order matters (folders 0-9). Restart the backend before each run because the login rate limiter allows only 5 attempts per 15 minutes.

item.name: 8.1 Login is rate limited (429 after repeated attempts)

request.description: Re-sends itself until the server answers 429 (max 20 tries). After this folder, logins are blocked for 15 minutes from this IP, so restart the backend before the next run.

exec: pm.test('Login endpoint returned 429 Too Many Requests', () => pm.response.to.have.status(429));
pm.test('429 body is JSON with a meaningful message', () => {
